panels.title: Compress both communication directions
panels.subtitle: CIFAR-100 · ResNet-20 · 10 clients · full participation · 100 rounds
panels.finding: FedCode reaches 14.6× joint reduction at 58.07% accuracy; FedAvg reaches 61.22%.

panels.title: Calibration sets the tradeoff
panels.subtitle: CIFAR-100 · ResNet-20 · 64 centers · upstream / downstream calibration
panels.finding: 264.7× reduction comes with a 46.88-point accuracy loss; the selected 0.2/0.5 setting loses 3.15 points.

takeaways: Joint savings need both routes: FedZip’s 19.8× upstream reduction becomes 1.9× when downloads are included.
Calibration preserves utility: sending codebooks alone produces the largest ratio and the largest accuracy loss.
